furniscene.name: FurniScene
furniscene.license_name: No public dataset license. The paper is arXiv 2401.03470 and its abstract says the dataset and code will be publicly available soon.
furniscene.notes: Checked 2026-09-29. arXiv v2 (6 May 2024) still says the dataset and code will be publicly available soon. Web search found no official download or repository. Skipped. This does not block Phase 1.

objaverse.name: Objaverse furniture subset
objaverse.license_name: Per-asset Sketchfab license from each object's metadata license field. The Objaverse package README also states ODC-By 1.0 for use of the Objaverse-XL dataset as a whole. Each GLB is logged on its own license, not under ODC-By alone.
objaverse.notes: Use objaverse 0.1.7 load_lvis_annotations and load_objects. Furniture category names are the LVIS keys in objaverse_furniture_categories.json. Target 160 GLB files. Not started until --confirm-download.
